entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EF 10: Nullable complex property with PropertyValues.ToObject() creates instance instead of null #37249
  • The linq expression 'ti' could not be translated (works in EF 9.0.11 and before) #37247

Closed

  • Cosmos: bulk execution #36599
    11.0.0
  • Contains with more than 5 items adds duplicate parameters at end #37245
  • Add ExecuteInsertAsync to support INSERT ... SELECT without loading data #37244
  • ComplexCollection (JSON) + QueryFilter on child entity → "Invalid column name '...'" when Parent.Include(Child) and FK nullable #37205
    10.0.2

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Fix empty scalar collection support #37248
  • Fix NullReferenceException in SqlServerAnnotationCodeGenerator when scaffolding columns with named default constraints and CLR default values #37243
  • Fix #37143: Always generate HasDiscriminator with type argument and property name in snapshot #37242

Merged

  • Add Cosmos bulk execution #37033
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0] Fix complex collection within left join subquery #37239
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.2

Updated

  • [release/10.0] Make FromSql work on entity types containing complex JSON #37235
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37240
